integrity: The classification is proved symbolically from the exponential-unitary divisor definitions; the finite checker is corroborative only. Literature comparisons distinguish harmonic-mean integrality from exponential-unitary perfectness.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for integers with one prime-power component \(p^a\), where \(a\ge2\), and a squarefree coprime cofactor; the density is for fixed \((a,p)\), with no uniformity or classification of all squarefree-generator pairs.
title: A squarefree-generator theorem for exponential-unitary harmonic numbers
